item.title: Violent Super Bowl Sunday in SJ: 2 killed, 5 injured in separate shootings
item.description: Both shootings come just steps away from where San Jose hosted watch parties and other events for the Super Bowl all week long.

item.title: Retail operator of outdoor sportswear pioneer Eddie Bauer files for bankruptcy
item.description: The operator is blaming declining sales and a litany of other industry headwinds.

item.title: Federal judge blocks California law that bans ICE agents from wearing masks
item.description: The judge said the law's exemption for state police discriminates against federal agents, though it could be rewritten without the exemption.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Rain returns tomorrow, bringing downpours, possibility of thunderstorms
item.description: A storm arrives tomorrow and rain will spread by the afternoon and continue through the evening and into Wednesday. Expect downpours at times, the possibility of thunderstorms and gusty winds in the hills.

item.title: Teachers strike closes SF schools as union, district at odds over pay and health care
item.description: San Francisco teachers are on strike for the first time in 47 years, demanding higher wages and more health care benefits. SFUSD officials said schools will be closed again on Tuesday as negotiations continue.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn addresses breaking leg in downhill crash at Winter Olympics; dad wants her to retire
item.description: Lindsey Vonn posted on social, addressing the scary crash she endured sustaining, "a complex tibia fracture" Sunday at the Winter Olympics, saying, "I have no regrets." Meanwhile, her dad said, he wants her to retire.

item.title: $15,000 worth of equipment stolen from Hayward Little League team's clubhouse
item.description: Treeview Little League in Hayward is out about $15,000 after their clubhouse was broken into and vandalized.

item.title: Here's what Super Bowl LX visitors are saying about San Francisco
item.description: For years, San Francisco has battled a global reputation problem - but the big game may have offered the city a rare PR win, as many visitors walked away with a far more positive impression than expected.

item.title: 49ers DL Keion White shot in ankle at post-Super Bowl event in SF, team says
item.description: San Francisco police say it happened on Mission Street near 14th, after an alleged altercation between two groups. They don't believe White was involved -- but he was shot in the crossfire.

item.title: Social media 'addicting the brains of children,' plaintiff's lawyer argues in landmark trial
item.description: The world's biggest social media companies face several landmark trials this year that seek to hold them responsible for harms to children who use their platforms.
